title: 21 April 1946
notes: The one silent picture in the film: the Keynes still held, no move, for all 25 s (music drops out). Same static crop as scenes 04 and 13 (Keynes alone; Kingsley Martin, beside him in the photograph, is out of frame).

DATE-21-APRIL-1946 is an overlay on V3, not a cut: it fades up just after 'Keynes died on' and away before 'The NHS would open'. premiere-plan.py's FADE gives it a 12-frame fade-in only; add the matching 12-frame fade-out by hand (or extend FADE to the tail).

Fade to black over the last 2 s: carried as "fade_out": 2.0 on 08-01. premiere-plan.py does not read that key (its DIP is 12 frames and would also fade the head in): set Opacity 100 → 0 over 423.0-425.0 s of the clip by hand, or on the movement DIP into scene 09.
The storyboard's restraint holds: no deathbed, no family, no claim he died of overwork.
orchestrator: 08-01 HOLD+FADEOUT = the last 2 s fade to black; 08-02 FADE = up and away (in and out).

clips.desc: Keynes at Monk's House, cropped to Keynes; HOLD, no move, the whole scene; fade to black over the last 2 s
